method: Actual architectural/public-ground separation, manually observed at native size. Shared terrace/quay paving, permanent retaining fascia and public outdoor stairs remain town scenery. Real building walls/columns, functional sculpture, detached structural feet, individual entrance stairs, coast and optional Grail remain construction. A boundary is not a support approval.

blacksmith.source_interpretation: Preserve the workshop, complete furnace/firebox and actual entry steps. The lower common court curb/fascia is permanent public ground, not the workshop foundation.
